quote: According to a leading treatise, “there is a split of authority” about whether Miranda warnings are required when the defendant’s attorney “arranged for the contact” but “was not present” during the questioning. 2 LaFave § 6.8(a).We need not consider that issue here.
cite: United States v. Dricko Huskey, 90 F.4th 651 (4th Cir. 2024)
